selected_branches.branch: Left-of-center passing and all components of the conditional allowance.

law_text: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the center of a two-lane, two-directional highway and overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction, unless such left side is clearly visible and is free of oncoming traffic for a sufficient distance ahead to permit such overtaking and passing to be completely made without interfering with the safe operation of any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction or any vehicle overtaken.

topic_inventory.exact-text: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the center of a two-lane, two-directional highway and overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction, unless such left side is clearly visible and is free of oncoming traffic for a sufficient distance ahead to permit such overtaking and passing to be completely made without interfering with the safe operation of any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction or any vehicle overtaken.

runtime_uncertainties: CARLA map selection must establish public-highway status, exactly two opposite-direction lanes and a reliable marked or definition-based centerline.
An actual opaque blocker must yield the intended virtual-observer visibility difference; its physical realization and pixels require original CARLA review.
Sufficient distance, clearly visible and interfering with safe operation are unresolved statutory judgments; engineering times, ray lengths and separation distances are recorded as measurements only.
Controlled response policies must be verified from original participant traces; scripted intent is not measured interference.
Exact executable constructions, finalizers, canonical proposals, source-bound compatibility, saved-only and independent audits remain CPU work.
